title: Sanjay Jewellers Ornamennts House Shop
description: A professional jewellery website designed to showcase collections and build customer trust through a clean and elegant online presence.
details: This project was designed for a jewellery business to present its gold, diamond, silver and bridal collections in an organized way. The website includes an about section, product highlights, gallery and direct contact options, making it easier for customers to explore the business and get in touch.

title: Amrit-Bhog Restaurent
description: A modern restaurant website created to present the menu, restaurant information and ordering options in a simple and welcoming way.
details: This project focuses on giving a local restaurant a professional online presence. It includes menu categories, the restaurant story, gallery, customer reviews, location details and an order request option, helping visitors quickly understand the restaurant and contact it for their orders.

title: Radha-Krishna Restaurent
description: A clean and interactive restaurant website designed to showcase the menu, dining experience and convenient ordering options.
details: This project was built for a pure vegetarian restaurant and focuses on making the food and dining experience easy to explore online. It includes menu categories, customer reviews, gallery, restaurant information and an interactive cart that guides customers toward the external ordering process.

title: Nocktuelle
description: A premium restaurant website concept designed with a sophisticated visual style to showcase the menu, atmosphere and table booking experience.
details: This project is a design showcase for a modern restaurant brand, combining elegant visuals with clear navigation and useful restaurant information. It includes signature dishes, restaurant story, reviews, gallery, opening hours and a table-booking section to create a complete premium dining experience.
